restoreJsonDescription: Upload a NinerLog JSON backup (from Export → Full Data Backup) to restore your flights, aircraft, licenses, class ratings, credentials, people, custom currency rules and custom reports.
restoreJsonNote: A backup restores into an empty account. If this account already holds data, you can replace it with the backup. Document files and instructor signatures are not part of a backup.
restoreJsonSummary: Your data was successfully imported into this account.
restoreJsonSummaryReplaced: Your previous logbook data was replaced with the backup.

history.title: Import History
history.subtitle: Previous CSV imports into this account.

restoreErrors.invalidJson: The selected file is not valid JSON.
restoreErrors.notABackup: The selected file is not a NinerLog JSON backup.
restoreErrors.tooLarge: This backup is larger than the 200 MB the server accepts.
restoreErrors.versionUnsupported: This backup was made by a newer version of NinerLog than this server runs. Update this installation, then restore the backup again.

restoreReplace.title: This account already holds logbook data
restoreReplace.body: A backup restores into an empty account only, so nothing has been changed yet.
restoreReplace.deletes: Replace everything deletes the current logbook data of this account — flights, aircraft, licenses, ratings, credentials, people, custom currency rules and custom reports — and restores the backup in its place.
restoreReplace.strict: Your logbook is in strict mode: every replaced flight is kept as a void record, and its history, mode changes and certifications stay. The backup's history is added to them.
restoreReplace.atomic: It is all-or-nothing: if anything goes wrong, your current data stays exactly as it is.
restoreReplace.confirm: Replace your current logbook data with this backup? This cannot be undone.

restoreBlocked.title: Replacing is not possible for this account
restoreBlocked.body: This account holds document files (license or credential scans) or signed flights. A backup does not carry those, so replacing would lose them.
restoreBlocked.options: Restore the backup into an empty account instead, or remove the document files and signed flights from this account first.
